A map, with receipts.

Each arrow is backed by a source line. A symbol reference can be a scoped function call, constructor selection, or callback registration; it is not proof that the code executes on every build or path. Import arrows show relative TypeScript module imports. These relationships can include calls, declarations, and macro-generated references.

Seventeen guided paths cover the user journeys. Overview maps introduce each path; chapter tabs focus on three source checkpoints at a time. Select a file to inspect symbols, then choose Explore file for its immediate callers and dependencies. Select a connection to read the evidence. GitHub links use the recorded commit; local source excerpts may include uncommitted edits.

Pan by dragging blank space, zoom with the wheel or controls, and use Fit view to reset. Search files or functions with /. Press Escape to clear search or close this dialog.
